title: The Book of the Tree

edition.name: The Annotated Book of the Tree
edition.basis: the annotated study-Bible format: a book introduction, pericope headings before a verse, footnotes sorted by kind, and a glossary that points at the verse it explains

note: Seed corpus, written so the checker has something to check and the genres are demonstrated; the prose is Kilo's to write. Rules the validator enforces: contiguous chapter and verse numbering; every citation in `cites`, and every glossary `see`, must resolve; any digit in a verse body, an annotation, a gloss or an introduction paragraph requires `source` naming a repository path that exists; every statute names a RULE present in MANDATES.md and a `check` path that exists, so a law with nothing executing it is refused; a section heading may carry no figure at all, because a heading is a label and not a claim; no email, phone number or forensic deny token; book and verse caps declared here and enforced. A `variant` is the textual apparatus: the circulated reading, where it came from, and the body retaining the reading of this codex.

glossary.gloss: the canon, the engine and the instruments that every package grows out of.
the variants and notes that record what a reading used to say, and why it stopped saying it.
a law bound to the check that executes it; a law with no check is a proverb and is filed as wisdom.

paragraphs: This book answers one question: why there is a tree at all, rather than a folder of scripts. It is not a history of the code; it is an account of a decision that made later decisions possible.

Read it for the shape of the claim. The trunk is canon, engine and instruments; the branches are the packages. A branch is a package only when it can stand alone, which is a claim about gates and not about file layout.

verses.text: In the beginning there was one tree, and the tree had a trunk, and the trunk held the canon.
And the trunk put forth branches: the forensic, and the behavioural, and the instruments that grade them.

annotations.note: The three are not a hierarchy. The instruments are named beside the branches because a package that grades nothing is a folder with a README.

verses.text: And the branches were one repository, and no branch was called a package until it could stand alone.

annotations.note: Standing alone means a manifest, a gate and a published tree, in that order; see the packaging plan.

verses.text: And the name of the tree was Azazael, and the name was not a product, nor a promise, nor a client.

paragraphs: This book is the law code, and every statute in it is bound to the check that executes it. That binding is the point of the book: a commandment with nothing running behind it teaches a reader to expect enforcement where there is none.
The statutes here are not new law. Each cites a rule already in the canon and points at the instrument that proves it is kept; where the two disagree, the canon governs and this book is wrong.

verses.text: A control shall be exercised before it is called a control, for an unexercised control is a decoration.

statute.why: the registry's self-test is the control that proves the registry matches the hook it claims to transcribe

annotations.note: Written after a control that had never been run was reported as in place, and read as working by everyone who saw it named.

verses.text: Every number shall be written with the command that produced it, and a number found without a command shall be struck out rather than trusted.

statute.why: the refusal is mechanical: a verse carrying a digit and no source fails before it can be quoted

annotations.note: A figure is quotable. A figure without its command is quotable and wrong, which is the worse of the two.

verses.text: A verdict shall name the predicate that fired, and the reader shall ask whether that predicate is the thing they care about.

statute.why: the registry distinguishes BLIND from PASS, because a gate that could not read its input has not judged it

annotations.note: "Predicate" is meant plainly: the exact condition that fired, not the topic it belongs to.

books.name: The Falls
books.subtitle: The Book of the Instruments That Lied

paragraphs: Doctrine in this canon is carried by failure, not by assertion. Each verse names a measurement that looked reassuring and was not, and each variant records the reading that circulated before anyone checked it.
The book is not a confession and the reader is not asked to be edified. It exists so that the next instrument of the same shape is recognised before it reports.

sections.heading: The fast path that never fired

verses.text: And the instrument was compared against itself, and the divergence came back small, and small was read as working.

variants.text: the divergence read 0.001 where the mean difference was 0.135

annotations.note: The comparison's hand side silently became the fitted side, so the instrument reported agreement with itself.

verses.text: And a probe reported an accelerator that was not in this box, because the reading came from another venv, and the gate was green throughout.

variants.text: an accelerator of 7.80 GB reported as available
variants.source: the bundled venv of another application, named in AGENTS.md

annotations.note: A green gate is a statement about the checks that ran, not about the reading that was copied from somewhere else.

verses.text: And the fast path fired never, and the ceiling that sat below the threshold read as caution rather than as silence.

variants.text: zero fires in 100 calls at any support

books.name: Psalms
books.subtitle: The Book of the Long Wait

paragraphs: A lament is not a lesson. It is the register in which a person who keeps the records is allowed to say how long the wait has been, and it is placed here so that the register exists in the canon and not only in conversation.
No verse in this book is evidence of anything, which is why none of them carries a statute. Read them as the sound the work makes, not as a finding.

verses.text: How long shall a lane say the suite is green, and the suite not be run?
How long shall a row be called closed, when the verb that closed it was not a verb the queue knew?
The dead store is not a metaphor. It is a row nobody reads, and it was counted twice, and the count was reported as coverage.
